_about: SHELF of French classics in English before 1931, works no other shelf holds: Racine's plays (Boswell's metrical version, 1890-97), Froissart's Chronicle in Lord Berners's Tudor translation (1523-25; Ker's Tudor Translations, 6 vols, 1901-03), Commines's Memoirs (Scoble, Bohn 1855-56), Thierry's Norman Conquest (Hazlitt, 1847) and Saint-Simon's Memoirs (Bayle St. John, Gutenberg). Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 96); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
